data.action: 站在圣坛前，双手合握心口银十字架，摘下眼镜抬眼露出含泪的浅笑。
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, altar portrait
data.description: 日光从教堂彩窗落到圣坛前，希耶尔换上有完整内衬的纯白露肩长婚纱，白色头纱落在齐颌蓝发旁。她摘下眼镜，双手在心口前合握一枚银十字架，微微抬起眼睛，深蓝眼眸里蓄着克制的泪光。婚纱裙摆铺落石阶，窗上的蓝白色光斑映亮她逐渐放松的笑容。
data.location: 洒满神圣彩窗光晕的宏伟教堂十字架圣坛前
data.promptProse: Ciel stands before the chapel altar without glasses, clasping a silver cross at her heart with both hands. Her opaque off-shoulder wedding gown and white veil frame chin-length blue hair, and restrained tears give way to a calmer smile. At medium eye level, the train rests on stone steps below the altar. Soft stained-glass daylight places blue-white patches over her skirt and veil, with pale reflected light beneath her chin.
data.title: 希耶尔 · 纯白圣堂的赎罪婚誓
